an6.22:1.1: chayime bhikkhave aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi taṃ suṇātha …pe…
an6.22:1.2: katame ca bhikkhave cha aparihāniyā dhammā
an6.22:1.3: na kammārāmatā na bhassārāmatā na niddārāmatā na saṅgaṇikārāmatā sovacassatā kalyāṇamittatā
an6.22:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave cha aparihāniyā dhammā
an6.22:2.1: ye hi keci bhikkhave atītamaddhānaṃ na parihāyiṃsu kusalehi dhammehi sabbe te imeheva chahi dhammehi na parihāyiṃsu kusalehi dhammehi
an6.22:2.2: ye hi keci bhikkhave anāgatamaddhānaṃ na parihāyissanti kusalehi dhammehi sabbe te imeheva chahi dhammehi na parihāyissanti kusalehi dhammehi
an6.22:2.3: ye hi keci bhikkhave etarahi na parihāyanti kusalehi dhammehi sabba te imeheva chahi dhammehi na parihāyanti kusalehi dhammehīti. 23
